subject.title: fix(scripts): bound GHSA patch GitHub lookups

question: Should the GHSA patch workflow intentionally fail closed after 60 seconds with SIGKILL for every GitHub CLI request and the origin lookup?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but the timeout value changes the maximum tolerated GitHub latency for a maintainer security-advisory workflow; source inspection and tests cannot determine the acceptable operational budget.

options.title: Accept the one-minute cutoff
options.body: Merge the bounded helper as written, treating a 60-second failure as preferable to consuming the surrounding workflow budget indefinitely.

options.title: Choose a different policy
options.body: Adjust the timeout or introduce an owner-approved retry/timeout policy if GHSA patch operations routinely need more than one minute.

recommendation.title: Accept the one-minute cutoff
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded helper as written, treating a 60-second failure as preferable to consuming the surrounding workflow budget indefinitely.
